review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for existing concepts that could compete with its declarations. The searches covered finite-fibre predicates (FiniteFibers, HasFiniteFibers, FiniteFiber), finite covering spaces (FiniteCovering), covering-map cardinality and finiteness lemmas, and fibre equivalences. They turned up no finite-fibre predicate and no finite-covering category in Mathlib. The only fibre equivalence found is `fiberEquivGroup` in the quotient-covering file, which is a different concept. The file builds on the repo's own `CoveringSpace.FullSubcategory` and `coveringFiberEquiv`, so it reuses the shared API and does not restate it. `Over.hasFiniteFibers` is an `ObjectProperty` and `FiniteCoveringSpace` is an abbrev of the generic full-subcategory type, so neither is a competing structure. I did not check whether `CoveringSpace.FullSubcategory` itself duplicates something in Mathlib, because that type is defined outside this file. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
